description: Torex XC6206P332MR — 3.3V fixed LDO regulator, 200mA max, ultra-low quiescent current ~1µA. SOT-23-3 package. Ultra-low dropout ~250mV at 100mA. Excellent for always-on battery rails with very light loads.
name: xc6206p332mr
watch_out_for: 3.3V fixed output, 200mA max. Dropout ~250mV at 100mA. Ultra-low quiescent current ~1µA. SOT-23-3 package. Input cap 1µF + output cap 1µF ceramic minimum. Not suitable for >200mA loads — step up to ME6211 or AP2112K.
